writeup: TIC 230163860 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 0.6675 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing a 3.97 percent dimming, with a signal-to-noise ratio of 29.4 in the transit detection statistics. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal at a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 14.1, though the centroid offset measured 3.5 arcsec from the target location. No secondary eclipse was detected. The object does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel candidate. The machine learning screening score of 0.50 indicates moderate confidence that this represents a real target. No data quality issues were flagged during processing.
